verdicts.reason: A: the Vienna row collides with the blue header, so its name is dark text on blue and its $109 price is lost. The city order is scrambled, the date lines are illegibly tiny, the disclaimer is set larger than the fare rows, and there is an odd white strip above the blue band. B has the same header collision on Madrid (price missing) and the same scrambled order and tiny dates. It is worse because the legal disclaimer sits in the middle of the fare list and splits it in two, and the list is indented off the headline's left edge, so it reads as broken.
